answer: A raven wins a meadow seal by sealed bid, and that bid locks as vault, forfeited whole if the vine it sponsors proves fake; one unproven vine per raven. The meadow sells one seal per epoch, each next minimum bid set at the last seal's price plus delta. Stacking k clones takes k serial epochs, the k-th seal costing base plus (k−1) delta of locked capital; a newcomer bids base once.
